issuer.summary: The issuer is FOUR entities, not one. Resilience (BVI) Ltd. (inc. 2024-10-23) issues the tokens; Resilience Foundation (Cayman) governs and acts as agent for holders; Cover Reinsurance SPC, Ltd. -- a Cayman Class B(iii) insurer regulated by CIMA -- carries the actual underwriting risk through Segregated Portfolio 1; and Resilience Inv SPC purchases the Notes. ⚠️ Holders have NO direct legal claim on the §114 reinsurance trust assets: the exposure runs through an unsecured, LIMITED-RECOURSE Principal-at-Risk Note against SP1 alone -- no cross-portfolio recourse, no recourse to general assets, no third-party guarantees -- ranking behind cedent and policyholder claims. The controls are genuine: Grant Thornton (Cayman) audits, and Fireblocks MPC multi-sig holds the critical oracle, redemption and access-manager keys. But the model is trust-the-operator rather than trust-the-code. ⚠️ Eleven months in market with no loss event carries less information than it would elsewhere -- insurance losses are back-loaded by quarters or years -- and the carrier and cedent counterparties are not disclosed, so a holder does not know whose book they are backing.
